title: Darts Calendar
summary: PDC tournament calendar as a website, a JSON file and a subscribable ICS feed, rebuilt and deployed every day.
intro: Darts Calendar is a slim tournament calendar for the PDC season. It collects upcoming events from public sources, normalises them and publishes the result in three shapes: a browsable website, a plain JSON file and an ICS feed you can subscribe to from any calendar app.

The site offers a card view and a table view, filters for broadcaster and series, a live badge for tournaments that are currently running, and a short "up next" list. Because the whole thing is rebuilt by a GitHub Action every morning, the schedule stays current without any manual work.

title: Metalcore Munich
statusNote: The beta is password-protected. Access is shared with the local scene, not published here.
summary: A pit-first show guide for the Munich metalcore, deathcore and hardcore scene, assembled from public venue data.
intro: Metalcore Munich answers one question: which shows in Munich are actually worth the trip this week? It pulls event calendars from local venues, merges duplicate entries, matches bands against a curated database and sorts everything into scene buckets from metalcore and deathcore to punk, rock and the occasional oddity.

Instead of marketing copy, each entry shows the facts that matter: start time, venue, support acts, genre tags, how many independent sources back the listing, and whether a show was updated, sold out or removed. A timeline view, venue ranking, band directory and a changelog of data changes round it off.
The site is currently in a community beta while the data pipeline and the scene taxonomy are being tuned. The public domain is coming once the beta phase settles.
